page.title: Components
page.intro: Every colour, font and component in one place, built from the design boards. Compare it with the board pictures in design/renders/. This page is on local and staging builds only.

sections.shell: Top bar, staff bar and footer

colours.intro: Every text and background pair the interface uses, with its contrast ratio. CI fails if any pair drops below WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for borders and the focus ring).

type.heading1: A page title in Bricolage Grotesque
type.lede: A lede in Inter, 18 px: the first line that tells the reader what the page is for.
type.body: Body text in Inter, 16 px, with a comfortable line height for reading longer passages.

forms.tooltipButton: Why we ask for your year of birth

ads.intro: Specimens only: real ads and sponsors arrive with S1-E12. The portrait and side boxes show only on screens 1200 px and wider.

shell.topBarNote: The full top bar from the boards. The live top bar shows only the pages that exist so far.
shell.staffBarNote: The staff bar from the admin boards. The admin site mounts it from S1-E11-01.

report.title: Report button
report.intro: The one Report action every kind of user content shows (S1-E10-01). It opens the report dialog with the item filled in. Signed in as a test persona, the report is real and lands in the moderation queue.

doodles.intro: The hand-drawn doodles from design/assets, drawn inline so they take their colours from the --doodle-* tokens. Light mode shows them exactly as drawn on the canvas; at night the ink turns light and every fill turns dark. The script scripts/doodle-tokens.ts keeps the files this way and CI fails on any raw colour.
doodles.all: All {{count}} doodles, in the page's current mode
